description: List Vigi-Sky's sky events: predicted bright ISS passes and Starlink trains for the next 48 hours, and clusters of witness reports with the explanation tested against them (compatible / contradicted / untestable / under review). Use it for 'what happened or will happen in the sky'; for one city's passes use iss_city_passes, for one past sighting use what_did_i_see. Public data only, no personal information.

kind.description: prevu = predicted passes only, signale = reported lights only; omit for both.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: fr (default) or en.

name: sky_events

outputSchema.description: Returns events [{id, kind, t_start, verdict, url, ...}], available.

title: Recent and upcoming sky events
